truth_clock: Truth describes last completed1ms physics step at the saved state; observer wrench represents a filtered preceding5ms interval. This is a sampled-clock comparison, not a computation-delay measurement.
interval_convention: Half-open windows; counts and 5ms sampled disagreement-equivalent seconds, not continuous wrong-contact durations.
